name: Beauty VS Zombie
detailed_description:
The apocalypse has arrived! Zombie hordes swarm, and demons roam free! But hope remains—gather gorgeous heroines from around the world; they are humanity's last line of defense! 《Beauty vs. Zombies》 is a unique game blending strategy tower defense with character collection and nurturing elements. Get ready to command your goddess squad and write your own legendary chapter in this gorgeous yet brutal post-apocalyptic war for survival!

【CORE GAMEPLAY】

  • Strategic Deployment, Tactical Victory: Inspired by classic tower defense, you'll strategically deploy your beauty units on meticulously designed battlefield grids, adapting to shifting enemy waves and terrain features. They will automatically attack incoming zombies and monsters to protect your base.

  • Team Composition, Synergistic Combat: Each beauty possesses unique skills, attack methods (melee blades, ranged firearms, AoE magic, etc.), and roles. Skillfully combine girls from diverse cultural backgrounds and abilities to build combat squads with powerful synergies – the key to overcoming your foes!

【GAME FEATURES】

  • [Diverse Roster of Beauties from Across Cultures]
    From Eastern swordswomen wielding katanas to Western witches chanting spells; from futuristic warriors piloting high-tech cannons to mythical heroes brandishing ancient divine weapons. Dozens (or more!) of unique beauties with distinct personalities, exquisite artwork, and diverse abilities await your summons. Collect and nurture them, unlock their exclusive stories, grow alongside them, and forge deep bonds.

  • [Monsters & Demons from East and West]
    You'll face more than just slow-moving common zombies! Encounter terrifying monstrosities from Eastern and Western myths and legends: swift mutants, tough stitched abominations, vampires, werewolves, Jiangshi kings, Painted Skin demons, mountain specters (Shanxiao)... Each enemy boasts unique attack patterns and weaknesses, testing your tactical adaptability.

  • [Rich Arsenal & Combat Styles]
    Experience the thrill of melee slashes, the roar of heavy firepower, and the dazzling spectacle of mystical magic! Different beauties excel in various combat styles, bringing endless possibilities to the battlefield. Witness a unique combat aesthetic where blades and spells clash with guns and cannons.

  • [Diverse Game Modes]

    • Classic Campaign (Single-Player Tower Defense): Follow the main storyline, tackle meticulously designed levels, and enjoy the escalating strategic fun of tower defense.

    • Side-by-Side (Co-op Mode): No more fighting alone! Team up with friends to defend against tougher invasions, share resources, coordinate deployments, and experience the deeper strategy and doubled fun of cooperation!

    • Enter the Fray (Special Mode): Tired of commanding from the rear? In specific challenge or event modes, get the chance to directly control powerful characters (perhaps even yourself, or special hero units?), charge into the thick of it alongside your beauties, and feel the visceral thrill of battling monsters head-on!

【JOIN THE FIGHT】

On the edge of this shattered world, forge bonds with your beauties and write an epic saga of resistance against despair. Use your wisdom and courage, assemble the ultimate lineup, and protect the last bastion of light!

Add 《Beauty vs. Zombies》 to your Wishlist now and prepare for a feast of strategy, nurturing, and thrilling combat!
